identity.title: List of Pokémon Sword & Shield volumes

leadText: The of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by VIZ Media in , which began with the first volume released in August 2021. Much like with the , the chapters from the original mini-volume releases in Japan of the Sword & Shield arc are collected in two separate smaller mini-volume releases for the VIZ release in North America with three to four chapters each. Once the Sun & Moon ends in the regular volumes, the Sword & Shield arc will be properly collected in that format as well. The series concluded when the fourteenth and final volume was published on December 9, 2025.
